title: Food, Health and Product Integrity Code Consolidation
jurisdiction: India; Union food, health and product-safety framework with State implementation interfaces
source_or_instruction: User requested consolidation and severe, safeguarded accountability for deliberate mass-harm food adulteration.
notes: In progress and not ready for introduction. Canonical operative drafts are 01-draft/not-ready-for-introduction-food-feed-and-delivery-integrity-bill.md (broad working Bill) and 01-draft/not-ready-for-introduction-bns-food-adulteration-amendment-bill.md (narrow BNS/BNSS Bill). The 2026-08-17 consolidation control register removes duplicate BNS/BNSS schedules from the broad Bill and assigns each remaining instrument a single legal route. The duplicate former grave-public-health-harm module was removed on 2026-08-17 after repository audit. Seven retained official source snapshots were accepted by the designated human reviewer on 2026-08-18; the acceptance record limits each to its identified snapshot and does not clear missing consolidated regulations, Rules or State/UT sources. A not-ready BNS filing dossier, official-retrieval job sheet, State/UT source matrix, final-readiness dashboard, clause-to-redline conversion queue and machine-readable remaining-source workboard were added on 2026-08-18. The 2026-08-17 desk simulation has a design-remediation record in 09-democratic-impact-monitor/simulation-corrective-action-register.md. Exact primary-source amendment schedules, remaining source acceptance, State/UT verification, competence/fiscal decisions, real pilot evidence and formal-readiness gates remain open.
